title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken: Kanwa - Luminous Memories
content:
I’d argue that season three should have been the recaped content featured here. It should have ended then and there.

Luminous Memories cover the better part of season 3, arguably the only decent portion of the story in that season. It goes through quickly highlighting the important blocks in Rimuru’s and Hinata’s conflict and how it all was put to rest. Long story short, it was just a game of misunderstanding.

Nothing else really stands out regarding this recap. I would giving credit that it does not have any of that annoying Veldora commentary like the other recaps. It’s relaxing and soothing. The beating he received atthe end was deserved at least.

Overall: 6.36/10.
